children: Only slugthrowers and missile weapons can be Upgraded as Slinkers. Once a weapon is made a Slinker, it can no longer fire normal ammunition (and Slinker ammunition costs twice the normal price). Slinkers are equipped with simple sensors and battle computers, and programmed to fly around obstacles or even around corners to strike a target.
